	}

# Group 4, tier box I: sets the chosen line to tier I (or drops the line if it is the ticked box)
custom_button = {
	name = dst_tier_menu_g4_t1
	tooltip = dst_tier_menu_g4_t1_tt
	potential = {
		dst_tier_menu_group_exists_trigger = { group = 4 }
	}
	trigger = {
		dst_tier_menu_line_chosen_trigger = { group = 4 }
	}
	effect = {
		dst_tier_menu_tier_effect = { group = 4 tier = 1 }
	}
	frame = { # ticked
		number = 2
		trigger = {
			is_variable_equal = {
				which = dst_tier_menu_group4_tier
				value = 1
			}
		}
	}
	frame = {
		number = 1
		trigger = {
			always = yes
		}
	}
}

custom_text_box = {
	name = dst_tier_menu_g4_t1_label
	potential = {
		dst_tier_menu_group_exists_trigger = { group = 4 }
	}
}

# Confirm pays for the chosen lines and grants them: the shop settles up and the state is cleared
custom_button = {
	name = dst_tier_menu_confirm
	tooltip = dst_tier_menu_confirm_tt
	potential = { }
	trigger = {
		dst_tier_menu_can_confirm_trigger = yes
	}
	effect = {
		dst_tier_menu_finish_effect = yes
	}
}

# Close keeps every choice: the Reopen decision (decisions/_DST_custom_gui_decisions.txt) brings the window back

	name = dst_tier_menu_close
	tooltip = dst_tier_menu_close_tt
	potential = { }
	trigger = { }
	effect = {
		clr_country_flag = dst_tier_menu_open
	}
}
